description: One bracket of the progressive personal income tax on monthly taxable income. A set of brackets applies from its effective_from until a later set starts.
The bracket's order within its set, from 1 (lowest).
Monthly taxable income where the bracket starts, VND.
Where the bracket ends, VND; empty for the top bracket.
Tax rate on the income within the bracket, as a fraction.
First day the set of brackets applies (ISO date text).
